Description: Company Description Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human. We are looking for a Data Scientist in Trust and Safety Analytics focused in Detection and Enforcement identifying and mitigating potential risks on the platform. If you are passionate about recognizing patterns, generating insights, and moving toward solutions for risk prevention, this is a great opportunity for you. As a Data Scientist in Trust and Safety, you will proactively identify marketplace risks and help remediate them by optimizing our controls program. If you find joy in a fast-paced environment, learn quickly, possess analytics experience, and have deep Trust & Safety domain knowledge, this could be the perfect match! This is a full-time position reporting to the Manager, Trust and Safety Analytics. What’s this team like at Etsy? The Trust & Safety Analytics team partners closely with leads across Trust & Safety and Product & Engineering to craft policy, ensure business goals are met or exceeded, and manage the rapidly changing environment of platform risks. More broadly, the Analytics team at Etsy helps drive the success of our partners by providing meaningful insights, industry-leading measurement techniques, and access to the metrics, data, and tools needed for decision-making and optimization. We partner with our peers through all stages of development: identifying initial opportunities, analyzing the impact of our efforts, and highlighting improvement areas. Ultimately, the team’s work strengthens Etsy and helps continuously improve the Etsy experience. What does the day-to-day look like? You will assess, define, and measure the success of controls and detections in partnership with Operations teams. You will design new controls in response to emerging risks, partnering with partner teams to develop and/or launch new controls. Title: Delivery Engineer, ML, Americas
Description: About Hilbert Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies. The Mission: Turn Ground Truth Into Growth Hilbert has two parts: a data foundation that gives our AI agents a high-fidelity view of each business, and an agentic web app where growth teams find and act on insights. The scores and audiences you build feed both: our agents reason with them, and our activation sends them into paid media and CRM. The hard problem Every customer's data is different, their compute may be ClickHouse, Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery, and their teams want proof, not promises. Your models have to work in that environment and show measured uplift. We want every pod to stay lean and efficient across very different customer environments, delivering quality work at startup speed. You focus on delivery; our sales engineers handle pre-sales. Your work centers on customers in your own region: supporting customers elsewhere is a rare exception, and your global work is mainly staying aligned with Hilbert colleagues in other regions. What You'll Do Feature stores: build customer-specific, point-in-time correct features on the data foundation. Models: train, tune and validate propensity, churn, lifetime value, uplift and custom models, starting from our ML templates and building custom models when a customer needs something the templates don't cover. New model types that many customers will need are built first by our product engineering team, and you roll them out to later customers. Model analysis: go beyond aggregate metrics to verify what each model has learned, what drives its scores, and how it behaves across segments and on edge cases. Deployment: models run in the customer's own environment or on our managed stack. In either case, understand the constraints, pin down the requirements, design the ML system to fit, and write the scores and audiences our agents and activation use. Measurement: own the statistical design inside our growth team's measurement plan, from power and holdout setup to uplift analysis. Trust: document models for the customer's data science and risk teams, then monitor and retrain them in production. Productization: turn repeated features and model patterns into product with our product engineering team. What Success Looks Like Audiences built from your models lift the agreed growth metric, such as conversion or retention, against a holdout group, and that result decides whether the customer takes them to production. Who You Are The translator: you explain a model to a customer's data science team and earn their trust. The experimenter: you'd rather prove uplift in a holdout test than show off an offline metric. The pilot: you get the most out of AI agents across model iterations, from feature ideas and experiment runs to error analysis, and help build them into how the team works. The systems thinker: you build reusable features, pipelines and automation instead of one-off models, so a small team can deliver across very different environments. Extensive applied ML experience on tabular customer data, with strong Python and ML libraries. Extensive hands-on deep learning experience, from designing architectures and loss functions to training and shipping models in production, with PyTorch or a similar framework. Feature engineering in SQL warehouses such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery. Working data engineering experience: building and debugging pipelines, data orchestration, data modeling and data quality checks, enough to own your feature pipelines end to end with our data engineers. Production ML with tools such as MLflow, Weights & Biases or Vertex AI. Solid experiment design and uplift measurement. Comfortable working in a distributed team across time zones. Fluent Spanish for roles based in Latin America. Nice to have DevOps, software architecture and security knowledge Growth-focused data projects experience Industry experience such as e-commerce, retail, fintech, telco and media Model governance in regulated industries such as banking and telco: model documentation, explainability and PII handling Able to travel to the US when necessary Reporting and location You report to your pod's Lead Delivery Engineer and work alongside our data delivery engineers and product engineering team. The role is based in Americas. Delivery runs remotely, with occasional visits to our largest customers. Why join us At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go. Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Title: Coordinador de Business Intelligence
Description: Grupo Ruz es una empresa mexicana con más de 30 años de experiencia en el desarrollo y distribución de productos con marcas reconocidas. A través de nuestras unidades de negocio Mobility y Toys, creamos productos innovadores que acompañan momentos importantes en la vida de nuestros consumidores, impulsados por el talento y la pasión de nuestros colaboradores. Objetivo del puesto Convertir la información de sell-out de nuestros clientes retail (Walmart, Costco, Liverpool, El Palacio de Hierro, Soriana, Chedraui, Sanborns, Amazon, Mercado Libre, entre otros) en datos confiables y accionables para la toma de decisiones comerciales. La persona será responsable de descargar, consolidar y depurar la información de los portales de proveedores, integrarla en Oracle FDI y traducirla en indicadores clave: venta por tienda y SKU, rotación e inventario, días de cobertura, quiebres de stock, sugeridos de resurtido y desempeño por cadena. Con estos hallazgos impulsará mejoras en pricing, mix de producto, surtido por formato, forecast y negociación con cada cliente. Responsabilidades principales 1. Extracción de información de portales retail Descargar de forma periódica (diaria, semanal y mensual) la información de sell-out, inventario y órdenes de compra de los portales de proveedores: Retail Link (Walmart), Costco, Liverpool, El Palacio de Hierro, Soriana, Chedraui, Sanborns, Amazon Vendor Central, Mercado Libre, entre otros. Mantener un calendario de descargas por cliente y asegurar que la información esté completa y a tiempo. Automatizar la extracción y carga de reportes cuando sea posible (macros, scripts, conectores o RPA). Administrar los accesos y usuarios a los portales en coordinación con el equipo comercial. 2. Transformación y calidad de datos Limpiar, homologar y consolidar la información de los distintos portales en una sola base de datos comercial. Mantener los catálogos maestros: equivalencia de SKU del cliente vs. SKU interno, tiendas, formatos, regiones y categorías. Validar la consistencia de la información (ventas vs. facturación, inventario vs. embarques) y documentar diferencias. Integrar la información en Oracle FDI mediante procesos de carga (ETL) confiables y documentados. 3. Análisis de sell-out e inventario Calcular y dar seguimiento a los indicadores clave por cliente, tienda, SKU y categoría: Venta en unidades y pesos (sell-out) vs. sell-in. Rotación de inventario y días de inventario / cobertura. Quiebres de stock (out-of-stock) y fill rate. Venta promedio por tienda por semana y productividad por punto de venta. Sell-through y desempeño de lanzamientos y temporadas (ej. Día del Niño, Buen Fin, Navidad). Inventario obsoleto o de lento movimiento. Generar sugeridos de resurtido y alertas de sobreinventario o desabasto por tienda. Analizar el impacto de precios, promociones y exhibiciones en el desempeño en anaquel. 4. Inteligencia comercial y toma de decisiones Traducir los hallazgos en recomendaciones concretas para el equipo comercial y la dirección: pricing, mix de producto, surtido por formato, cobertura y negociación con cada cadena. Preparar información de soporte para juntas con clientes (revisiones de negocio, planes de temporada, negociaciones). Apoyar la planeación comercial y el forecast de ventas con base en la demanda real del consumidor (sell-out). Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento, venta cruzada y riesgos por cliente, canal y producto. 5. Administración del BI (Oracle FDI) Administrar, mantener y dar soporte al módulo de BI dentro de Oracle FDI. Construir y actualizar tableros de sell-out, inventario y desempeño por cliente retail. Crear nuevas visualizaciones, KPIs y reportes; modificar modelos de datos, cálculos, métricas y jerarquías cuando se requiera. Capacitar a los usuarios comerciales en el uso de los tableros. Requisitos técnicos Portales de proveedores retail: experiencia descargando y trabajando información de Retail Link (Walmart) y/o portales de Costco, Liverpool, El Palacio de Hierro, Soriana, Chedraui o Amazon — indispensable. Excel avanzado: tablas dinámicas, Power Query, BUSCARX / ÍNDICE-COINCIDIR, macros — indispensable. Herramientas de BI: Oracle FDI u Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC); deseable experiencia con Power BI, Tableau o Qlik. Automatización: Python, VBA, Power Automate o RPA para extracción y carga de reportes (deseable). Conocimientos de scripting del stack de Oracle (PL/SQL, Groovy) — deseable. Formación académica Licenciatura en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración, Economía, Actuaría, Sistemas Computacionales, Data Science o carreras afines. Deseable: especialización o certificaciones en Business Intelligence, Analítica de Datos u Oracle Analytics. Experiencia requerida Mínimo 2-3 años en análisis comercial, sell-out, category management, demand planning o BI. Experiencia demostrable en empresas proveedoras de autoservicio y departamentales (consumo, juguetes, electrónica, movilidad o similares). Experiencia trabajando con equipos comerciales y de cuentas clave, entendiendo sus KPIs. Experiencia construyendo tableros y reportes en plataformas de BI. Competencias clave Pensamiento analítico y orientación a resultados de negocio. Capacidad para comunicar datos de forma clara y convertirlos en recomendaciones (storytelling con datos). Atención al detalle y disciplina en la calidad de la información. Proactividad para automatizar procesos repetitivos. Trabajo en equipo con áreas comerciales, planeación, finanzas y cadena de suministro.

Title: Fraud and Abuse Head, Financial Services Mexico
Description: Description Lead the end-to-end fraud defense for a high-growth financial product in Mexico while directly shaping the balance between loss containment, customer experience, and approval rates. If you thrive on making high-stakes decisions with imperfect data and turning fraud signals into actionable rules, this is your opportunity to build and scale a fraud prevention function from the ground up. As the Fraud Prevention Head, you will design and execute the fraud prevention strategy across three critical stages: account onboarding, transaction monitoring, and post-transaction behavior analysis. To succeed, you must demonstrate a disciplined, evidence-based approach to rule design—combined with the sound judgment needed to operate under pressure and make critical decisions when information is incomplete. Success in this role is measured by fraud loss, detection and false positive rates and First Payment Default rate attributed to fraud. Experience in financial services fraud prevention, digital origination channels, knowledge of identity and validation vendors in Mexico, blacklists, device signals, and geolocation tools is a plus. Key job responsibilities You will manage the full ecosystem—including identity verification, biometrics, and document validation—while building and refining fraud rules and models grounded in evidence and data. You will own the loss taxonomy and lead the attribution process between fraud and credit risk in close partnership with the Credit Risk team, ensuring clear accountability and precise measurement. Your scope extends beyond external threats: you will lead the detection of internal fraud in coordination with business partners and the Payment Risk department and manage the disputes to ensure compliance with onboarding rules. You will serve as the primary liaison for incident reporting with Ops, AML, Legal, and Information Security teams, ensuring swift and coordinated responses. A day in the life You will monitor and tune the fraud prevention framework. This includes overseeing fraud alerts, following transaction anomaly dashboards, reviewing false positive rates to ensure legitimate customers are not being unnecessarily blocked, assessing detection rate trends against fraud loss targets and tracking First Payment Default cases attributed to fraud. You will analyze data to assess whether newly detected patterns warrant rule adjustments, model recalibrations, or escalation to the identity and biometrics vendors. You will join working sessions with Ops, AML, Legal, and BRP to coordinate active incident investigations, share intelligence on suspicious activity. Title: Sustainability data advisor
Description: About Watershed Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team. We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us! The role We are looking for a customer-focused and analytically-minded individual to be a member of our Mexico City office on the Sustainability data advisory team. This is an opportunity to join a core team at a growth-stage start-up that works with the world's top companies to accelerate their sustainability programs. You'll work directly with customers as a trusted advisor, leading measurement sessions and delivering advisory services that unlock the full value of our platform — enabling our customers to gain clear, reliable insights into their sustainability impact and achieve their sustainability goals. You will: Advise sustainability teams at many of the world’s top companies. You’ll work directly with customers on how to measure actionable carbon and non-carbon footprints to reach sustainability goals and enable real reductions, ranging from scoping new measurements to in-depth methodology comparisons between footprints. Deliver services that accelerate customer success, helping customers set up their measurements to meet sustainability goals, serving as a trusted partner in emissions verifications, and providing specialized advisory to optimize their data and methodologies. You'll ensure customers unlock maximum value from Watershed's platform faster and more effectively than they could on their own. Collaborate with science, engineering, and product teams to pioneer innovative measurement solutions and expand Watershed's sustainability intelligence layer. You might be a fit if you: Have 4-6 years of experience in a consulting, solutions-engineering, or other customer-facing role. You are excited to work directly with customers to help them set the foundation for world-class sustainability programs. Have experience in sustainability-related fields, greenhouse gas accounting and/or ESG reporting. Are an excellent verbal and written communicator. You can communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences. Learn quickly and operate well in ambiguity. You are organized, systematic, and efficient. You thrive in a high-volume environment. Think clearly about complex problems, and are comfortable using and speaking to data. You are meticulous and detail-obsessed. Are passionate about solving climate change and excited to contribute to doing so at a fast-paced startup. Have strong English language proficiency This position is required to be in person in our Mexico City office 4 days per week. Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles) Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so. What’s the interview process like? It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process. What if I need accommodations for my interview? At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. Title: Manager Revenue
Description: Grupo Smart Fit es la mayor plataforma de fitness y bienestar de América Latina y uno de los grupos de más rápido crecimiento en el mundo. Con presencia en más de 16 países, más de 2,000 clubes, más de 23 mil colaboradores y un ecosistema completo de marcas, impactamos a millones de personas todos los días a través de experiencias que promueven la salud, el ejercicio y la calidad de vida. Segmentación y tierización de unidades : Definir y optimizar la clasificación de unidades de acuerdo con su demanda, ocupación, margen y entorno competitivo, buscando maximizar la rentabilidad por unidad. Gestión de promociones y descuentos: Desarrollar y evaluar campañas promocionales con base en casos de negocio, midiendo su impacto en ingresos, conversión y ticket promedio. (Concluida indispensable) Experiencia general : 4 a 6 años trabajando en industrias como membresías, retail, consumo, telecomunicaciones u hotelería. Experiencia especializada: Al menos 3 años desempeñando funciones de pricing, Revenue Management, análisis financiero o gestión de P&L. Idiomas : Inglés intermedio - avanzado. Herramientas: Excel avanzado (modelación financiera y tablas dinámicas), Power BI o Tableau. SQL deseable y dominio de Google Workspace. Certificaciones: Deseables en Revenue Management, Pricing o Análisis Financiero. Conocimientos técnicos : Estrategias de precios, Revenue Management, análisis financiero, P&L, presupuestos, modelación de datos, evaluación de promociones y elasticidad de precios. Soft Skills : Toma de decisiones, liderazgo, iniciativa, trabajo en equipo y organización. Title: Senior Revops Engineer
Description: About Improvado Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. AI and automation Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output. Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided. Ownership Be the single Rev Ops contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric. Requirements 4-6+ years in Rev Ops, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2 B Saa S, with hands‑on admin of a live Salesforce org. Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus. Deep knowledge of the B2 B Saa S revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals. Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM. Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use. Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked. Nice to have Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification. Click House or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool. Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools. Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems. Hub Spot to Salesforce migration. Attribution or CS health score data. Martech or analytics company background. What We Offer Remote-first environment Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises 20 working days of PTO per year US holidays and additional days off Professional development reimbursement

Title: Senior .Net Developer Ai
Description: About Delinea Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long.
